# Fixture Rules

Fixtures must be entirely synthetic and manually authored. Use invented titles, people, paths, identifiers, and short study passages. Do not copy or adapt content from StudyVault, textbooks, exercise images, Basic Memory, chat transcripts, or archives, even after redaction.

The repository `.gitignore` excludes common personal media and data formats while explicitly allowing this directory so future synthetic fixtures can be committed. Before adding any binary fixture, document that it is synthetic and why the test needs it. Prefer small text fixtures when they provide the same test coverage.
